svg.title: CYC connected engineering workflow
svg.desc: Twelve responsibilities inside Scout, Build, Verify and Deliver. Arrows connect the work, developer decisions, knowledge inputs, diagnostic returns, separate ready and blocked outcomes, and independent publication and accepted-learning branches. Complete text explanations accompany the diagram.
svg.text: Common implementation route · 12 responsibilities inside 4 recorded stages

a.aria-label: 1. Define observable success — read the step explanation
a.text: 1. Define observable success
Record the outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria.
Skills: Scout · Frame when the goal is unclear

a.aria-label: 2. Select route & risk — read the step explanation
a.text: 2. Select route & risk
Choose the playbook, checks and review depth.
Skills: Scout · Challenge for high-risk work

a.aria-label: 3. Retrieve matched history — read the step explanation
a.text: 3. Retrieve matched history
Find component decisions and prior failed approaches.Carry the relevant constraints into the plan.
Skills: Context · Error Ledger

a.aria-label: 4. Revalidate that history — read the step explanation
a.text: 4. Revalidate that history
Compare recorded claims with current code and changes.Replace stale assumptions before relying on them.
Skills: Context · Understand when evidence conflicts

a.aria-label: 5. Trace impact & choose design — read the step explanation
a.text: 5. Trace impact & choose design
Follow writers, readers, state and interface contracts.Name affected consumers and a check for each.
Skills: Impact · Design · Understand as needed

a.aria-label: 6. Explain & settle decisions — read the step explanation
a.text: 6. Explain & settle decisions
Connect present behavior to the proposed mechanism.Resolve decisions that could change the solution.
Skills: Scout · Teach only for a requested lesson

a.aria-label: 7. Plan evaluable slices — read the step explanation
a.text: 7. Plan evaluable slices
Give each slice an observable outcome and check.High risk: challenge the plan; otherwise proceed.
Skills: Scout · Challenge for high-risk plans

a.aria-label: 8. Build in tested slices — read the step explanation
a.text: 8. Build in tested slices
Reproduce or pin behavior, implement, inspect the diff.Explain the effect on dependent components.
Skills: Build · Error Ledger when attempts fail

a.aria-label: 9. Retain useful project knowledge — read the step explanation
a.text: 9. Retain useful project knowledge
Update component docs and index when learning is useful.Keep verified facts; label undecided proposals as pending.Finalize authorized context and ledger edits before checks.
Skills: Context · Error Ledger for failure history

a.aria-label: 10. Prove tests & verify behavior — read the step explanation
a.text: 10. Prove tests & verify behavior
Original-code proof where required; run configured checks.Exercise affected consumers against stable covered files.
Skills: Verify

a.aria-label: 11. Review intent & code quality — read the step explanation
a.text: 11. Review intent & code quality
Inspect intent, consumers and project conventions.Resolve or dismiss findings with recorded evidence.
Skills: Verify · Challenge for consequential review

a.aria-label: 12. Account for outcome & learning — read the step explanation
a.text: 12. Account for outcome & learning
Record criteria, limits, learning and ledger disposition.Reuse the shared review and explain maintenance.
Skills: Deliver · Context for retained learning

svg.text: Settled alignment and named consumerswith checks are required to pass.

g.text: Require current evidence, criteria and artifact checks.
Design still valid → repair the code.Repeat affected checks and current review.
Revisit context, impact and design.Update the plan and consumer checks.
Old evidence describes different files.Repeat verification AND semantic review.
R4 · Check observes the wrong thing
Correct an unprotected target or assertion.Protected check / config → new authorized run.
More patches cannot supply missing input.Preserve findings; do not claim completion.
Blocked, exhausted or halted · retain evidence
At record, verify, retry, resume and complete:did protected or out-of-scope files change?No: continue the requested operation.
Preserve the changed files for review; no rollback.Resolve scope / authorization before a new run.The halted run cannot resume.
HOST DELIVERY GATE · enforced when the hook is active

Ready: this session’s relevant touched runs are complete and applicable response checks pass.Blocked: disclose the unfinished outcome with current review evidence and applicable native reply checks.An actively running unfinished run must continue or be recorded with an appropriate non-running outcome.
Show the candidate, evidence, reasoning and limits.
No completion claim or publication path.Blocked run: may resume after resolving input.Exhausted / halted: new run; fresh evidence.
Review the actual change and its evidence. Completion is not human acceptance or permission to publish.Publication and acceptance of a pending finding are separate decisions.
Reuse the generated review; satisfy project rules.Requested revisions after completion use a new run.
Only if a pending finding exists and is accepted.Separately reviewed documentation update.Merge is not a prerequisite.

docs/context/<area>.mddocs/context/INDEX.mdOne document per component or area.Decisions, dead ends and gotchasPaths, revision and check evidenceUpdate at 9 when useful; index by path.Read at 3; revalidate at 4.Retain verified technical facts.Adopt decisions with acceptance.

Error signatures, attempts and resultsConfirmed causes; regression guardsRead at 3. Record attempts duringimplementation AND recovery.Required at delivery for bug-fix runsor any run with recorded failures.
Choose how to investigate and build.Exercise the actual user behavior.Select the route at 2.Use the relevant checks at 10.

Configurable defaults:3 recorded failures; stop earlier at2 consecutive identical signatures.A recorded rewind invalidatesdependent later handoffs andexecutable verification.Returning never resets the budget.Unreported attempts are not visible.

Criterion and consumer resultsCommand receipts and file fingerprintsReview findings and resolution evidenceRetry history and retained reasoningLocal by default; share through review.The controller validates records andcurrent covered files. It cannot provethat tests are meaningful or anagent’s judgment is correct.

svg.text: A completed run is terminal. Later requested revisions start a new scoped run with fresh evidence.
Ordinary path: run start records Scout; run finish batches Build recording, proof, checks, Verify, Deliver and completion.
R1–R4: match source cards to return arrows.Dots join paths; other crossings stay separate.
Arrows: teal = forward work · amber = recovery · blue = developer decisions · red = unfinished outcome
Dashed purple = knowledge read / write. The 12 responsibilities are not separate runtime states. Other playbooks have their own sequences.
Skills = CYC methods selected as needed, not automatic dispatch. Click a numbered step for its trigger, worked example and expected evidence.
Next task retrieves and revalidates the retained knowledge
